obligations.text: Each namespace has its own list of repositories: a namespace does not see another namespace's repositories unless its repository storage is mapped there.
obligations.cases: namespace with repository globals mapped vs unmapped
obligations.observation: repository visible in the namespace's list
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70 (iter12 namespaces.rs; not linked from this block)

parent.entailment: Beyond the children the parent promises only that repository lists are per namespace (#1, graded directly). The kind list is definitional. No composition credited.

obligations.text: Modules installed from a read-only repository always install in normal mode, never in developer mode.
obligations.cases: install -dev from a ReadOnly=1 vs ReadOnly=0 repository
obligations.observation: stored DeveloperMode of the installed module
obligations.gap: No model reads Repo/Definition.cls::ReadOnly. Decider Utils/Module.cls:1280 (ReadOnlyGetStored forces DeveloperMode=0 after the update-required check); writer the %IPM.Storage.Module save; reader the module list/DeveloperMode. Missing contrast: the same install -dev from a read-only vs writable repository gives DeveloperMode 0 vs 1.

obligations.text: IPM uses a repository for prerelease versions only when the repository is set up for them.
obligations.cases: repository Prereleases=0 vs 1 offering a prerelease; command override
obligations.gap: versions.rs takes the prerelease flag as an input and only for the filesystem index (count(repo_c(),false)==1). The flag resolution in Repo/Manager.cls::SearchRepositoriesForModule:99-108 (criteria IncludePrerelease overrides the server Prereleases) and remote/ORAS listing filters are unmodeled. Missing contrast: remote and ORAS repositories with Prereleases=0 vs 1 offering 2.0.0-beta.1, observing the selected version.

obligations.text: IPM uses a repository for +snapshot builds only when the repository is set up for them.
obligations.gap: No model of the Snapshots repository flag. iter24 snapshot_dependencies.rs models IsSnapshot and the force-snapshot reinstall, not repository eligibility. Members: Repo/Manager.cls:103-108 (IncludeSnapshots from criteria or tServer.Snapshots), Repo/Utils.cls:95. Missing contrast: a repository with Snapshots=0 vs 1 offering only 1.0.0+snapshot: not found vs installed.

obligations.text: IPM searches only enabled repositories for a module.
obligations.cases: enabled vs disabled repository offering the module
obligations.gap: repo_visited has an enabled parameter but no neighbour assertion or control sets it false. Missing contrast at Repo/Manager.cls::SearchRepositoriesForModule: a disabled repository offering a higher version is not visited and the enabled one supplies the install.

obligations.text: A <repo>/<module> prefix limits the search to one repository.
obligations.cases: qualified vs unqualified request with two repositories offering the module
obligations.gap: registry_match is an input to repo_visited/visits_filesystem and is never exercised false. Missing contrast: install other/M with repositories main (2.0.0) and other (1.0.0) installs 1.0.0 from other; unqualified installs 2.0.0 from main (Main.cls install argument parsing -> SearchCriteria.Registry).

obligations.text: A request containing keywords skips filesystem repositories, even when the filesystem repository is explicitly named; ordinary name searches can use them.
obligations.cases: filesystem vs remote repository; keywords vs none
obligations.basis: reused:repositories metadata (iter3 public_repairs.rs; control keyword-search-visits-filesystem rejected)

obligations.text: Keyword text is split on spaces with empty pieces dropped, so a keyword string of only spaces counts as no keywords and filesystem repositories are searched.
obligations.cases: spaces-only vs padded word; text vs $list vs object input

obligations.text: The module name is lowercased before any repository is asked.
IPM takes the highest version that satisfies the request, whichever repository offers it.
obligations.cases: newer version in a later repository vs older in an earlier one

obligations.text: As built (C:D39), a filesystem repository offers one version per module, the first row after re-sorting by version columns with prerelease compared as text and a release after its own prereleases, so an unversioned install picks 2.0.0-beta.1 over 2.0.0 and 1.0.0-rc.2 over 1.0.0-rc.10.
obligations.cases: repo_d (2.0.0, 2.0.0-beta.1) and repo_c (rc.2, rc.10): installed vs semantic max

obligations.text: The filesystem version index itself lists versions in version order.
obligations.cases: rc.10 vs rc.2 index position; prerelease included vs excluded

obligations.text: When several repositories offer the selected version, the one created first wins; a repository's sort position does not change this.
obligations.cases: equal version in two repositories with any sort values
obligations.basis: reused:repositories metadata (temp_repo.rs; better ignores the sort field for all inputs)

obligations.text: An explicit install version constrains the module actually installed: a successful request for 1.0.0 must not silently install 2.0.0.
obligations.cases: explicit 1.0.0 with stable vs edited filesystem source
obligations.basis: reused:repositories metadata (iter21 temporal.rs; C:D32: stale_one succeeds with installed version 2 for a 1.0.0 request)

obligations.text: An AllVersions search groups matching versions into one result per module, selecting the newest eligible version and listing eligible versions newest to oldest.
obligations.observation: row count, selected version, version list

obligations.text: Filtering happens before the grouped result is formed: a <3.0.0 search selects 2 and lists 2,1.
